en: An old postcard showing a black-and-white street scene with several multi-story buildings, awnings, and people walking. There are German signs visible such as 'D. A. Wachsler Zahnarzt' (dentist) and 'R. Jaber Dampfmehl' as well as the names 'Finz Fasching' and 'Jakominiplatz'. The postcard has decorative elements including a heraldic lion and a shield in black, red, and gold colors on the lower right, and features text in Gothic script.
